model: ex vivo healthy human skin venules
setup: CXCL8 injection into excised skin; 120 min incubation
controls: primary antibody specificity and ex vivo tissue context
observed_result: DARC and CXCL8 ultrastructural colocalization on basal membrane, intracellular vesicles, apical/luminal surface
interpretation_boundary: Morphological route; not flux, human brain, or stroke; n=2 donors

setup: CCL2 35 nM applied to basolateral face; 30 min and 2 h
controls: unstimulated polarized cells; immuno-EM and confocal
observed_result: ACKR1 moves basal->vesicular->apical microvilli after cognate CCL2 engagement
interpretation_boundary: Engineered kidney cells; cannot assume human brain endothelial itinerary

setup: 125I-CCL2 on basolateral side; 3 h, 16 h; TCA fractionation
observed_result: Higher intact basal->apical transport in DARC cells (P=0.0005 at 3h, P=0.003 at 16h)
interpretation_boundary: Positive reverse-direction evidence, not desired blood->brain

setup: TCA precipitate + gel autoradiography of cellular/apical fractions
observed_result: Full-length intact CCL2 band present in receptor-associated intracellular and apical fractions
interpretation_boundary: Intact receptor-bound chemokine, not demonstrated soluble parenchymal release

setup: 125I-CCL2 placed above monolayer
observed_result: DARC increases surface binding and some uptake, but NOT fluid-phase apical-to-basal transport
interpretation_boundary: Direct negative for tested ligand/model, not impossibility of all future engineered binders

model: MDCK-DARC cells grown under inverted filter orientation
setup: Cells grown on bottom side of inserts
observed_result: Direction remained basolateral-to-apical; not simply filter configuration
interpretation_boundary: Result described as data not shown; no underlying image to audit

setup: Comparable ligand setup with CXCL8
observed_result: Authors report same directional pattern for CXCL8
interpretation_boundary: Reported data not shown; no direct standalone figure

setup: CCL19 with or without cognate CCL2
observed_result: CCL19 not internalized or transported; CCL2 does not trigger nonspecific CCL19 transfer
interpretation_boundary: Noncognate specificity reported but supplementary image unavailable

setup: TCA soluble vs precipitable after basal/apical ligand administration
observed_result: DARC has negligible degradation basal->apical and modest apical exposure degradation vs D6
interpretation_boundary: Not proof of intact peptide delivery in reverse direction

setup: basal CCL2 -> apical receiver 3h
observed_result: DARC enhances basal->apical CCL2 transport in human-derived endothelium
interpretation_boundary: Overexpressing HUVEC not adult human brain EC

setup: CCL2 supplied apically
controls: matched mock; apical binding, internalization, lower soluble fractions
observed_result: Apical ligand binds/internalizes, but DARC does not enhance basolateral soluble CCL2 delivery
interpretation_boundary: Direct model-specific negative in target therapeutic direction

setup: measure inulin diffusion/electrical resistance with CCL2
observed_result: DARC transfection does not explain transport through a leakier monolayer
figure_or_table: Supplementary Fig4 cited (NOT UPLOADED); PDF p4
interpretation_boundary: Underlying supplemental plot unavailable; cannot independently audit magnitude

setup: transwell and artificial sink by periodic upper-chamber fluid exchange
observed_result: More transmigration DARC: ~1.6x standard and ~4.3x under flow-mimic condition
interpretation_boundary: Leukocyte egress is inflammatory effect, not therapeutic cargo transport

setup: CCL2 basal; 4h transmigration
observed_result: DARC enhances monocyte transmigration
interpretation_boundary: Functional safety liability; transfected peripheral endothelial model

setup: intradermal/intraperitoneal chemokine injection
observed_result: Enhanced local neutrophils and MPO activity when endothelial DARC overexpressed
interpretation_boundary: No BBB or peptide, but vascular inflammatory physiology

setup: contact hypersensitivity ear challenge
observed_result: DARC overexpression increases ear swelling/weight and inflammatory histology
interpretation_boundary: Demonstrates pro-inflammatory potential, not peptide-induced toxicity

setup: antisense in situ hybridization day14 EAE vs healthy
observed_result: Darc mRNA in inflamed vessels, not healthy controls; also cerebellar neurons
interpretation_boundary: EAE is not ischemic D02; neuron expression adds extra-vascular caution

model: mouse EAE spinal cord and brain
setup: PECAM1/CD45/DARC immunostaining days7/11/13
observed_result: DARC protein first detectable in inflamed venules day7, before clinical EAE
interpretation_boundary: Venular signal does not imply uniformly high capillary luminal density

setup: IHC of white matter/meninges
observed_result: More ACKR1+ vessels in MS vs control, P=0.0282; subset of vessels
interpretation_boundary: Multiple sclerosis rather than human ischemic stroke; postmortem, case mix

model: fresh mouse microvessels; pMBMEC and bEnd5 cultures
setup: TNF 16h in cultures
observed_result: Darc increased ~5-6x in pMBMEC and ~10x in bEnd5 after TNF
interpretation_boundary: Cell culture and induced inflammation context; not D02 protein levels

setup: TNF-treated cultured primary brain EC immunofluorescence
controls: Darc-/- negative control and rabbit IgG
observed_result: Surface-specific DARC detected on individual TNF-stimulated WT cells
interpretation_boundary: Staining positive in selected cells; no native human ischemic BBB luminal quantification

setup: transwell permeability +/-TNF
observed_result: No meaningful genotype-dependent difference in dextran leak
interpretation_boundary: Rules out large leak differences in this model, not all paracellular confounds

setup: ELISA of apical receiver at 3h
observed_result: Darc-/- TNF-stimulated cells made less CCL2, but 3h endogenous output low vs exogenous input
interpretation_boundary: Important source of confounding; properly considered by authors

setup: 30ng basal CCL2; ELISA upper compartment at 1,2,3h +/- TNF
controls: receptor KO, unstimulated WT, nonbinding CCL21
observed_result: WT TNF-stimulated reverse flux substantially increased, not in Darc-/- cells
interpretation_boundary: ELISA immunoreactivity, no orthogonal intactness; no reverse-to-therapy route

setup: 30ng basal CCL5; ELISA apical at 1,2,3h +/- TNF
observed_result: WT TNF-enhanced reverse flux, KO no equivalent response
interpretation_boundary: ELISA not MS intactness; no short-peptide or blood->brain assay

setup: same transwell CCL21 (noncognate) and CXCL1
observed_result: No ACKR1-dependent augmentation for CXCL1/CCL21
interpretation_boundary: Receptor promiscuity not universal productive transport, species dependent

model: Darc-/- C57BL6 and SJL EAE models
setup: MOG35-55 and PLP139-151 immunizations
observed_result: Darc deficiency ameliorates acute EAE in both strains; chronic benefit in C57BL6
interpretation_boundary: Global KO phenotype cannot be attributed to peptide binding/blockade

setup: 3H-thymidine proliferation recall day6/day9
observed_result: Comparable proliferation despite differential EAE severity
interpretation_boundary: Implies endothelial/trafficking mechanism, not no immune risk

setup: plasma cytokine array and CXCL1 ELISA
controls: erythroid DARC present/absent in different chimeras
observed_result: Sustained elevated CXCL1 requires erythrocyte DARC; RBC is chemokine reservoir
interpretation_boundary: Erythrocyte protein risk not captured by immune RNA measurements; EAE context

model: reciprocal bone marrow chimeric EAE mice
setup: Darc-/- and WT hosts with WT/KO bone marrow
observed_result: Loss of nonhematopoietic/vascular DARC attenuates EAE, erythrocyte deletion alone not sufficient
interpretation_boundary: Host nonhematopoietic includes more than brain endothelium; verify compartment attribution

setup: vessel count with collagen-IV
observed_result: DARC immunoreactivity on subset of vessels, higher in inflamed tissue, including normal-appearing WM
interpretation_boundary: Luminal density and stroke time courses require targeted human tissue studies

setup: calcium/cAMP/NanoBiT Gi/Gs/Gq and broader G protein panel
observed_result: No canonical G protein signaling detected upon CCL7
interpretation_boundary: No G-protein coupling does not prove physiologically inert binder

setup: BRET + NanoBiT GRK2/3/5/6 assays
observed_result: No significant CCL7-dependent GRK recruitment to DARC
interpretation_boundary: May still signal via noncanonical proteins

setup: NanoBiT, coIP, confocal, TANGO, DARC-V2R chimera
observed_result: No canonical beta-arrestin binding/translocation under tests
interpretation_boundary: Different cell types/ligands can differ; no blanket safety claim

setup: TiO2 phosphopeptide enrichment/LC-MS/MS basal vs CCL7
controls: paired untreated controls, four biological replicates
observed_result: ~8215 phosphopeptides (>2600 proteins), ~300 proteins with differential phospho-signature
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory; not direct pathway causal proof; raw S1 supplement missing

setup: cross-linking coIP-MS +/-CCL7
observed_result: ~1700 proteins identified; 73 interactions changed; 66 overlaps with phosphoproteomic proteins
interpretation_boundary: Associations, not confirmed endothelial trafficking or transcytosis

setup: coIP under crosslinked and non-crosslinked conditions
observed_result: ACKR1/CD82 coIP present at baseline, not significantly changed by CCL7
interpretation_boundary: May influence metastasis biology; no BBB transport demonstrated

setup: size-exclusion chromatography apo vs CCL7/Nb52 combinations
observed_result: CCL7 and Nb52 can bind receptor concurrently by SEC evidence
interpretation_boundary: Nb52 binding not equivalent to peptide shuttle; Data S1 underlying figures missing

setup: cryo-EM reconstruction full-length human ACKR1 + CCL7, apparent dimer
controls: apo receptor reference and EM map
observed_result: 3.65 Angstrom model, PDB 8JPS; targetable extracellular N-terminal interface
interpretation_boundary: Dimer nonphysiological arrangement possible; flexible N-terminal region unresolved

setup: cryo-EM contact interpretation
observed_result: N-terminal Glu46-Asn55 dock into CCL7 groove, plus outer TM6/7 and ECL3
interpretation_boundary: Native epitope may overlap physiological chemokine, pathogen/toxin binding sites

setup: cryo-EM structure; contact comparison
observed_result: Cys51-Cys276 disulfide supports extracellular N-terminal orientation; interface near CCL7 disulfides
interpretation_boundary: Preserve fold and disulfide in docking; do not model isolated flexible peptide as native receptor

setup: structure alignment CRS1 and CRS2
controls: PDB 7XA3 CCL2-CCR2 and additional chemokine complex structures
observed_result: CCL7 binds shallow CRS1; no strong CRS2 engagement unlike canonical receptors
interpretation_boundary: Receptor promiscuity, ligand-specific contacts, chemokine competition

setup: refinement and model maps
controls: C2 vs C1 refinement, apo and bound
observed_result: Nb52 density unresolved; distal proximal N-terminus missing despite full-length construct
interpretation_boundary: Do not infer accessible noncompeting short-peptide epitope from missing coordinates

setup: structural superpositions
observed_result: TM5/TM6 shortened, cytoplasmic TM3 kink and short ICL2 weaken transducer-binding cavity
interpretation_boundary: Structural hypotheses not direct evidence of lower toxicity or transport direction

setup: deuterium exchange of apo vs ligand-bound receptor
observed_result: Changes in ECL1, TM3, ECL2, intracellular TM5 despite shallow extracellular binding
figure_or_table: FigS8 and TableS5 cited; PDF p14
interpretation_boundary: HDX limited sequence coverage; supplemental measurement not provided

setup: hit lists phosphoproteomics and MS interactome
observed_result: Rab11-FIP1/Snapin/Raftlin/EHBP1/Rabex5 appear as possible transport-related factors
interpretation_boundary: Annotation of global candidate hits, not direct receptor-mediated transport tests
